0022600006.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Philadelphia 76ers, who have also not yet played a 2026-27 game. Cleveland is without Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back), while Khalifa Diop (knee) and Sam Merrill (elbow soreness) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (ruptured Achilles), Dean Wade (ankle sprain), Dominick Barlow (back), and Tacko Fall (hip), and the Cavaliers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 115-101 win in Cleveland on March 9, 2026.
